title: c24 on the gateway side: a moved gateway whose counted receipts take two different fallback fixes, so the hour is dropped and counted
reasoning: Every receipt is a radio receipt at c42-g from c42-r with relay_node 20, c42-r's own low byte: a direct hop, relayer c42-r, link_source relay_node (lnk_01). Relayer and gateway differ (lnk_03); every RSSI and SNR is in range (lnk_06).
c42-r's only position is its 16-bit cell (c42-m001), sent the day before, so it is stationary at every receipt with that cell, r16, as its box (lnk_02).

c42-g's 20-bit cells of 21 and 22 October (c42-m002 and c42-m003) do not overlap (their latitude intervals are disjoint) and their stored coordinates are 1000.315 m apart, beyond the 40 m floor. Both lie in the 7 days before every receipt, so c42-g has moved at every receipt and takes the position nearest in time within 30 minutes (lnk_02, Q5). lnk_02 applies to 'the relayer or the gateway', so the gateway end follows the same steps as c24's relayer.

Fallback for the gateway: at 10:10 the fix X (c42-m004, 10:05, 5 minutes before) is within 30 minutes and Y (c42-m005, 10:45, 35 minutes after) is not; at 10:40 Y (5 minutes after) is and X (35 minutes before) is not; at 10:50 Y (5 minutes before) is and X (45 minutes before) is not. So the receipts use x32, y32 and y32.
Step 6: c42-g is not stationary at the hour's receipts, so each receipt keeps its own box.

Each receipt passes lnk_05 on its own boxes: r16 to x32 is 1768.971 m and r16 to y32 is 1758.882 m, inside 500 to 60 000 m, and r16's longitude interval is disjoint from both 32-bit cells. These are c24's distances with the ends swapped, since the geodesic between two box centres does not depend on which end is which. All three are counted.

Over the counted receipts the gateway used two boxes, x32 and y32, so the link-hour is dropped and counted in mart_data_quality (lnk_02: a link-hour in which the relayer or the gateway used more than one box is dropped; Q6 and Q9). The one-box test comes before lnk_04's 3 packets, so the rule is lnk_02. An implementation that applies the one-box test to the relayer only keeps this hour.
